name: $V_R = V_S - V_F$
content: Voltage across the current limiting resistor
e: Voltage across the current limiting resistor is written VR = VS - VF. Voltage is potential difference, energy per unit charge between two points. Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path.

name: $R = \frac{V_R}{I} = \frac{V_S - V_F}{I}$
e: Current limiting resistance is written R = (VR)/(I) = (VS - VF)/(I). Current is charge passing a point each second, and it needs a closed path. Resistance opposes current and turns electrical energy into heat.
